//@version=6
indicator("QB diagnostic seeded flat and keywords v6", overlay=false)
age = bar_index - (last_bar_index - 20)
s = age < 0 ? na : age < 4 ? 5.0 : 2.0
h = age < 0 ? na : age < 4 ? 10.0 : 1.0
l = age < 0 ? na : age < 4 ? 0.0 : 1.0
plot(age, title="age")
plot(s, title="source")
plot(h, title="high")
plot(l, title="low")
plot(ta.stoch(s,h,l,3), title="stoch")
plot(ta.stoch(length=3, low=l, high=h, source=s), title="stoch_keywords")
plot(ta.cum(source=s), title="cum_keywords")
plot(ta.linreg(offset=1,length=3,source=s), title="linreg_keywords")
plot(ta.vwma(length=3,source=s), title="vwma_keywords")
plot(ta.roc(length=1,source=s), title="roc_keywords")
plot(ta.cci(length=3,source=s), title="cci_keywords")
